  - |
    cat > /home/cloud-user/install-ocp.sh << 'SCRIPTEOF'
    #!/bin/bash
    set -e
    cd /home/cloud-user
    
    # Skip if cluster is already installed (pattern deploy)
    if [ -f /home/cloud-user/ocp-install/auth/kubeconfig ]; then
      echo 'Cluster already installed, skipping.'
      exit 0
    fi
    
    # Wait for network. Test DNS reachability to 8.8.8.8 (a TCP/UDP:53
    # resolve) rather than ICMP ping, since gateway egress policy may
    # block icmp while still allowing DNS/HTTPS the install needs.
    echo 'Waiting for network...'
    net_ok() { timeout 2 bash -c '</dev/tcp/8.8.8.8/53' &>/dev/null; }
    for i in $(seq 1 15); do
      net_ok && break
      sleep 2
    done
    if ! net_ok; then
      echo 'ERROR: No network connectivity after 30 seconds'
      exit 1
    fi
    echo 'Network OK'
    
    OCP_VERSION=4.20
    
    # Download openshift-install and oc if not present
    if [ ! -f openshift-install ]; then
      echo "Downloading openshift-install $OCP_VERSION..."
      curl -L -o /tmp/openshift-install.tar.gz https://mirror.openshift.com/pub/openshift-v4/x86_64/clients/ocp/stable-4.20/openshift-install-linux.tar.gz
      tar xzf /tmp/openshift-install.tar.gz && rm -f /tmp/openshift-install.tar.gz
      echo "Downloading oc client..."
      curl -L -o /tmp/openshift-client.tar.gz https://mirror.openshift.com/pub/openshift-v4/x86_64/clients/ocp/stable-4.20/openshift-client-linux.tar.gz
      tar xzf /tmp/openshift-client.tar.gz && rm -f /tmp/openshift-client.tar.gz
      sudo mv oc kubectl /usr/bin/
      echo "Downloaded openshift-install and oc"
    fi
    
    echo ''
    echo '================================================'
    echo 'OCP Agent-Based Installer Ready'
    echo '================================================'
    echo ''
    echo 'install-config.yaml:  ~/ocp-install/install-config.yaml'
    echo 'agent-config.yaml:    ~/ocp-install/agent-config.yaml'
    echo 'Pull secret:          ~/pull-secret.json'
    echo 'openshift-install:    ~/openshift-install'
    echo ''
    echo 'To create agent ISO and install:'
    echo '  cd ~/ocp-install'
    echo '  ~/openshift-install agent create image --dir .'
    echo '  # Serve ISO and boot nodes via BMC'
    echo '  ~/openshift-install agent wait-for install-complete --dir . --log-level debug'
    echo ''
    echo ''
    # Auto-run agent-based installer
    INSTALL_START=$(date +%s)
    echo "Install started at $(date)"
    BMC_PASS='pw'
    echo 'Creating agent ISO...'
    cd /home/cloud-user/ocp-install
    cp install-config.yaml install-config.yaml.bak
    cp agent-config.yaml agent-config.yaml.bak
    [ -d openshift ] && cp -a openshift openshift.bak
    /home/cloud-user/openshift-install agent create image --dir . --log-level debug 2>&1 | awk '/v2GetClusterNotFound/ { next } /Unable to retrieve cluster metadata from Agent Rest API/ { next } /Agent Rest API never initialized\. Bootstrap Kube API never initialized/ { next } /Writing image to disk: 100%/ && !_disk_done++ { print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " " $0; print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " Disk image written; node will reboot into the installed OS. Progress may pause for several minutes."; fflush(); next } { print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " " $0; fflush() }' | tee /home/cloud-user/create-image.log
    
    echo 'Agent ISO created. Serving via HTTP and booting nodes...'
    # Open firewall for ISO serving (script runs as cloud-user)
    sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp --permanent 2>/dev/null && sudo firewall-cmd --reload 2>/dev/null || true
    cd /home/cloud-user/ocp-install
    nohup python3 -m http.server 8080 > /tmp/http-server.log 2>&1 &
    HTTP_PID=$!
    echo "HTTP server PID: $HTTP_PID"
    
    # Boot each CP node via Redfish virtual media
    BASTION_IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
    ISO_URL="http://${BASTION_IP}:8080/agent.x86_64.iso"
    echo "ISO URL: $ISO_URL"
    # Wait until the server actually listens. On rebuild the BMC is often
    # already up, so the Redfish path can race python -m http.server startup
    # and fail with a false 'ISO not reachable' before bind completes.
    for _iso_try in $(seq 1 30); do
      if curl -sfI --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 3 "$ISO_URL" >/dev/null; then
        echo "ISO HTTP server ready"
        break
      fi
      if ! kill -0 "$HTTP_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "ERROR: ISO HTTP server (pid $HTTP_PID) exited before becoming ready"
        cat /tmp/http-server.log 2>/dev/null || true
        exit 1
      fi
      echo "  waiting for ISO HTTP server (attempt $_iso_try)..."
      sleep 1
    done
    if ! curl -sfI --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 3 "$ISO_URL" >/dev/null; then
      echo "ERROR: agent ISO not reachable at $ISO_URL after waiting"
      cat /tmp/http-server.log 2>/dev/null || true
      exit 1
    fi
    
    for BMC_IP in 192.168.100.10 192.168.100.11; do
      echo "Mounting ISO on BMC $BMC_IP..."
      # Get system UUID from sushy. Retry until the BMC answers: the BMC
      # emulator (pod/process) may not be ready the instant this runs, and
      # this pipeline is otherwise unguarded — under set -e/pipefail a
      # single not-ready BMC would abort the whole (multi-node) install.
      # The `&&` list is set -e safe (only its last command can abort).
      # curl timeouts so a half-open BMC cannot stall a retry forever.
      SYS_ID=""
      for _try in $(seq 1 30); do
        SYS_ID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['Members'][0]['@odata.id'].split('/')[-1])" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$SYS_ID" ] && break
        echo "  BMC $BMC_IP not ready yet (attempt $_try); retrying..."
        sleep 5
      done
      if [ -z "$SYS_ID" ]; then echo "  WARNING: BMC $BMC_IP never became ready; skipping"; continue; fi
      echo "  System: $SYS_ID"
      # Confirm the ISO HTTP server is still alive before asking sushy to fetch.
      if ! curl -sfI --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 10 "$ISO_URL" >/dev/null; then
        echo "ERROR: agent ISO not reachable at $ISO_URL (HTTP server dead?)"
        exit 1
      fi
      # Insert virtual media (Systems path, HTTP, with auth).
      # Long max-time: sushy downloads the full ISO before answering.
      # POST curl failure/timeout is NON-fatal: on nested CI the client can
      # drop while sushy still finishes attaching. We poll Inserted below
      # and only exit 1 if media never becomes Inserted (fail-fast) — that
      # way wait-for still runs when the node actually booted the agent.
      set +e
      curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 900 -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X POST "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}/VirtualMedia/Cd/Actions/VirtualMedia.InsertMedia" \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -d "{\"Image\": \"${ISO_URL}\", \"Inserted\": true, \"WriteProtected\": true}"
      _ins_rc=$?
      set -e
      if [ "$_ins_rc" != "0" ]; then
        echo "  WARNING: InsertMedia POST returned $_ins_rc on $BMC_IP; polling Inserted..."
      fi
      _ins_deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + 900 ))
      INSERTED=""
      while true; do
        INSERTED=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}/VirtualMedia/Cd" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('Inserted',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        if [ "$INSERTED" = "True" ] || [ "$INSERTED" = "true" ]; then
          echo "  VirtualMedia Inserted on $BMC_IP"
          break
        fi
        if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$_ins_deadline" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: VirtualMedia not Inserted on $BMC_IP after 900s (Inserted=$INSERTED ISO_URL=$ISO_URL)"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "  waiting for VirtualMedia Inserted on $BMC_IP (Inserted=$INSERTED)..."
        sleep 15
      done
      # InsertMedia attaches the CDROM but leaves BootSourceOverride on Hdd.
      # Without Cd override the node reboots into an empty disk (agent never
      # starts). Continuous (not Once): some BMCs revert Once on Reset.
      # Continuous MUST be cleared + ISO ejected at disk-write 100% (see
      # _start_disk_write_eject_watch_cmd) — otherwise the post-disk guest
      # reboot re-enters the agent ISO. Final eject after install-complete
      # remains as a safety net.
      curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X PATCH "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}" \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -d "{\"Boot\": {\"BootSourceOverrideEnabled\": \"Continuous\", \"BootSourceOverrideTarget\": \"Cd\"}}" >/dev/null
      # Power on from ISO when off; reboot when already running (ForceRestart
      # is a no-op on a shut-off libvirt domain).
      POWER=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('PowerState',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
      case "$POWER" in Off|PoweringOff) RESET=On;; *) RESET=ForceRestart;; esac
      curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X POST "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset" \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -d "{\"ResetType\": \"${RESET}\"}" || true
      echo "Booted $BMC_IP from ISO (ResetType=$RESET, was $POWER)"
    done
    
    
    echo 'Waiting for cluster installation to complete...'
    # Disk-write 100%: do not Redfish-eject/ForceRestart (KubeVirt BMC VMI delete would cut the assisted pivot).
    (
      for _dw in $(seq 1 360); do
        if grep -q 'Writing image to disk: 100%' /home/cloud-user/ocp-install/install.log 2>/dev/null; then
          echo 'Disk image written — leaving BMC media alone so assisted can finalize and soft-reboot into the installed OS'
          break
        fi
        sleep 5
      done
    ) &
    _DISK_EJECT_WATCH_PID=$!
    /home/cloud-user/openshift-install agent wait-for install-complete --dir /home/cloud-user/ocp-install --log-level debug 2>&1 | awk '/v2GetClusterNotFound/ { next } /Unable to retrieve cluster metadata from Agent Rest API/ { next } /Agent Rest API never initialized\. Bootstrap Kube API never initialized/ { next } /Writing image to disk: 100%/ && !_disk_done++ { print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " " $0; print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " Disk image written; node will reboot into the installed OS. Progress may pause for several minutes."; fflush(); next } { print strftime("[%H:%M:%S]") " " $0; fflush() }' | tee -a /home/cloud-user/ocp-install/install.log
    OCP_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
    kill $_DISK_EJECT_WATCH_PID 2>/dev/null || true
    INSTALL_END=$(date +%s)
    ELAPSED=$(( INSTALL_END - INSTALL_START ))
    echo ''
    echo '================================================'
    if [ $OCP_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Install FAILED at $(date) (exit code $OCP_EXIT)"
    echo "Total time: $(( ELAPSED / 60 )) min $(( ELAPSED % 60 )) sec"
    echo '================================================'
    kill $HTTP_PID 2>/dev/null
    exit 1
    fi
    echo "Install completed at $(date)"
    echo "Total time: $(( ELAPSED / 60 )) min $(( ELAPSED % 60 )) sec"
    echo '================================================'
    # Eject agent ISO via Redfish virtual media
    echo 'Ejecting agent ISO from nodes...'
    for BMC_IP in 192.168.100.10 192.168.100.11; do
      echo "Ejecting agent ISO from BMC $BMC_IP..."
      SYS_ID=""
      for _try in $(seq 1 30); do
        SYS_ID=$(curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['Members'][0]['@odata.id'].split('/')[-1])" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$SYS_ID" ] && break
        echo "  BMC $BMC_IP not ready yet (attempt $_try); retrying..."
        sleep 5
      done
      if [ -z "$SYS_ID" ]; then echo "  WARNING: BMC $BMC_IP unreachable; ISO NOT ejected (node may re-boot from CD)"; continue; fi
      curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X PATCH "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}" \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -d "{\"Boot\": {\"BootSourceOverrideEnabled\": \"Disabled\", \"BootSourceOverrideTarget\": \"Hdd\"}}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      curl -s --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 -u admin:$BMC_PASS -X POST "http://${BMC_IP}:8000/redfish/v1/Systems/${SYS_ID}/VirtualMedia/Cd/Actions/VirtualMedia.EjectMedia" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    done
    # Write static MOTD with cluster credentials
    KUBEADMIN_PW=$(cat /home/cloud-user/ocp-install/auth/kubeadmin-password)
    printf '\nOpenShift Console: https://console-openshift-console.apps.ocp.ocp.local\nUsername:          kubeadmin\nPassword:          %s\n\n' "$KUBEADMIN_PW" | sudo tee /etc/motd >/dev/null
    # Trust the OCP CA so Firefox doesn't show cert warnings
    export KUBECONFIG=/home/cloud-user/ocp-install/auth/kubeconfig
    oc get secret -n openshift-ingress router-certs-default -o jsonpath='{.data.tls\.crt}' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d | sudo tee /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ocp-ingress.pem >/dev/null && sudo update-ca-trust
    # Save kubeadmin password into Firefox via headless Selenium
    if ! find /home/cloud-user/.mozilla/firefox -maxdepth 2 -name cert9.db 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
      firefox --headless --no-remote >/dev/null 2>&1 &
      FXPID=$!
      sleep 5
      kill $FXPID 2>/dev/null; wait $FXPID 2>/dev/null || true
      sleep 2
    fi
    if [ ! -x /usr/local/bin/geckodriver ]; then
      curl -sfL https://github.com/mozilla/geckodriver/releases/download/v0.37.0/geckodriver-v0.37.0-linux64.tar.gz | sudo tar xz -C /usr/local/bin/ || true
      sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/geckodriver 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    python3 -c 'import selenium' 2>/dev/null || pip3 install --user selenium 2>/dev/null || true
    echo '' | base64 -d > /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py
    chown cloud-user:cloud-user /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py
    chmod 755 /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py
    pkill -x firefox 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 2
    export GECKODRIVER_PATH=/usr/local/bin/geckodriver
    python3 /home/cloud-user/ocp-autologin.py https://console-openshift-console.apps.ocp.ocp.local 2>&1 || true
    # Cleanup: remove cached ISO, temp files, and pull secret from disk
    rm -f /home/cloud-user/pull-secret.json
    rm -rf /home/cloud-user/.cache/agent/ /tmp/http-server.log /tmp/cookies /tmp/*.zip /var/tmp/dnf-*
    dnf clean all 2>/dev/null
    # Kill the HTTP server used to serve the agent ISO
    kill $HTTP_PID 2>/dev/null
    SCRIPTEOF
    chown cloud-user:cloud-user /home/cloud-user/install-ocp.sh
    chmod 755 /home/cloud-user/install-ocp.sh
